import ctypes

def gsl_power(base, exponent):
    # Load libraries with correct order and mode
    cblas = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
    gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")
    
    # Configure function prototype
    gsl.gsl_pow_int.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_int]
    gsl.gsl_pow_int.restype = ctypes.c_double
    
    # Handle division by zero error
    if base == 0.0 and exponent < 0:
        raise ValueError("Cannot raise 0 to a negative power")
    
    return gsl.gsl_pow_int(base, exponent)

def assert_test():
    # Test basic positive exponents
    assert abs(gsl_power(2.0, 3) - 8.0) < 1e-10
    assert abs(gsl_power(5.0, 2) - 25.0) < 1e-10
    
    # Test negative exponents
    assert abs(gsl_power(2.0, -2) - 0.25) < 1e-10
    assert abs(gsl_power(10.0, -1) - 0.1) < 1e-10
    
    # Test zero exponent
    assert abs(gsl_power(5.0, 0) - 1.0) < 1e-10
    assert abs(gsl_power(-3.0, 0) - 1.0) < 1e-10
    
    # Test fractional base
    assert abs(gsl_power(0.5, 2) - 0.25) < 1e-10
    assert abs(gsl_power(2.5, 3) - 15.625) < 1e-10
    
    # Test error case
    try:
        gsl_power(0.0, -5)
        assert False, "Should have raised ValueError"
    except ValueError:
        pass

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
    print("All tests passed!")
